whatsNew:
• Fixed Multi-Camera Slot Fallback Bug: Resolved an issue where selecting alternative camera slot indexes (Left/Right/Rear) mistakenly fell back to the front camera (slot 0) on some BYD models.
• Live Camera Slot Mapping in Studio: Users can now switch and preview hardware camera slots (Index 0..5) live inside Calibration Studio with real-time screen update.
• Instant Hot-Swap Feed: Instant camera feed reconnection when changing AVM Camera ID or slot mapping without needing to exit the app.
• Fixed BYD Dolphin False Red Flashing Alert: Completely decoupled generic cluster blind-area flags and uncalibrated Area 1000 registers from directional PIP red alert borders.
notes: Fixed camera slot index fallback bug (forcing front camera on Atto 3 / Dolphin)
